newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: SKorean BOK sells dollars at 863.00 to support won.
newsitem.headline: SKorean BOK sells dollars at 863.00 to support won.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea was seen selling dollars at 863.00 won in Monday morning trading to slow the U.S. unit's climb against the domestic currency, dealers said.
The central bank also offered to sell dollars at 875.00 won in three-month forward trading and at 886.00 won in six-month forward trading, they added.
The central bank refused to comment on talk of its intervention in the interbank market.
The won continued to fall to 863.90 just after the intervention. It had opened the day's trading at 857.70, after closing on Friday at 857.10.
